name: vtuber-frontend
description: Transparent, always-on-top VRM companion overlay for the ai-assistant backend (Electron + three.js + @pixiv/three-vrm).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node electron/launch.js"
